findings.quote: I would like to thank the Secretary-General for placing before us the defining imperatives of our era, namely artificial intelligence, the climate crisis, and deepening global inequalities.
findings.rationale: Identifies AI as a defining UN policy challenge.

findings.quote: Will the age of the AI become another instrument of global inequality, or will it be a catalyst for our collective growth?
findings.rationale: Addresses Global South leadership, AI inequality and Ethiopia's AI university initiative.
